components.name: InputFill
components.description: Text field that formats as you type against a fixed mask: phone numbers, dates, card numbers, codes. Literals are inserted for you, characters that don't fit are dropped, and the rest of the template stays visible as a faint fill after what's been typed.

props.name: label
props.description: Floating label. Used by the filled and outlined variants.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Text inside the field before the value, e.g. "$" or "https://".

props.name: error
props.description: Error to show under the field, e.g. from the server. Marks the field invalid and overrides the built-in checks while set.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner in the trailing slot and marks the field busy.

props.name: containerClassName
props.description: Classes for the wrapper that holds the adornments. Falls back onto the input when there is no wrapper.

props.name: suffix
props.description: Text inside the field after the value, e.g. "ft" or "%".

props.name: invalid
props.description: Shows the error style. Same as passing aria-invalid.

props.name: leading
props.description: Decorative content before the text, usually an icon. Defaults to a search icon when type="search".

props.name: trailing
props.description: Content after the text, usually an icon.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Keyboard hint on the right, e.g. "⌘K".

props.name: clearable
props.description: Shows a clear button once the field has a value. Defaults to true when type="search".

props.name: revealable
props.description: Adds a show/hide toggle when type="password".

props.name: onValidityChange
props.description: Fires when the field's validity changes, whether or not the error is showing yet.

props.name: mask
props.description: 9 = digit, a = letter, A = letter (uppercased), * = letter or digit. Anything else is a literal; escape a token with \\.

props.name: template
props.description: Hint for the unfilled part, same length as the mask. Defaults to the mask with tokens shown as "_".

props.name: showFill
props.description: Shows the unfilled part of the template after the caret while typing.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Fires once every token is filled.
